draw_order: steam frame (full canvas, transparent except the active steam area)

stable_idle.notes: Fully transparent - no steam. Pipe looks exactly like the plain background.

unstable.notes: Realistic textured steam, revised per feedback: every puff now runs through an SVG turbulence/displacement filter for ragged, irregular edges (not smooth blobs), uses elongated upward-streaking wisp shapes instead of round puffs, varies opacity per-wisp, and mixes warm-white (near the leak) and cool-grey (further out) tones for depth. Loop-seam fix: every puff plays exactly one cycle per loop at a staggered start, and frames are sampled from the animation's SECOND cycle rather than the first, avoiding a one-time startup artifact that caused a visible pop at the wrap. Verified seamless (wrap-frame pixel difference is in line with every other frame transition, not a spike).

settle.notes: One-shot transition from unstable back to stable_idle using the same realistic texture treatment. New puffs stop spawning partway through and shrink/quicken as the leak dies down; ends effectively fully transparent (negligible trace, imperceptible), matching stable_idle for a clean hand-off.

suggested_flow: Hold stable_idle during calm play. On a fault trigger, switch to unstable (looping). When resolved, play settle once, then return to stable_idle.
